notes.title: Echoes of the Past: The Final Attempt Begins
notes.notes: [h1]Echoes of the Past[/h1][p]Now it’s clear before the island was cursed, it was a place of worship. [/p][p]A place mortals provided offerings seeking the blessing and trust from Tz'akabaak, the earth god, but as we know betrayal shattered that pact, and the spirit was trapped beneath the very altars built in his name. Through the years the temples crumbled down and the jungle took everything back. [/p][p]Now someone new has arrived. Henry is not the first to walk this path. Over the years, many historians, researchers and believers have tried to uncover the truth behind this island all driven by obsession, or purpose. Many inspired by  legends like David Livingstone, embark on this mission, however, the island doesn't take this intrusion lightly, only few can venture deep into the island and come back unharmed. The remnants of those who came before are still here: crumbled notebooks, shattered equipment and overgrown camps can be found throughout Dreadbone. The jungle keeps what it wants. [/p][p]One of them was Henry’s own grandfather. That’s the reason why he is here now, to uncover what happened to him, did the island capture him? He’s not just chasing myths he is following a trial that went cold decades ago, his family was on to something.[/p][p]Soon you'll be able to resolve this mystery yourself, enjoy this teaser of what's to come![/p][previewyoutube="yOlw5sE0zzE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]It’s been such an amazing journey for the whole team, it’s been months since we started this project. From concepts and ideas to finally a concrete and finalized demo. The team has worked so hard and tirelessly through many long nights, truly showing their passion and commitment towards Dreadbone. There is still more to come, but for now let's enjoy this incredible success together! [/p][p][b]Progress Update:[/b] In this last few weeks we have been implementing an immaculate UI and a beautiful credit scene, the VFX and SFX teams have been fixing and refining effects, while the design department has been fixing bugs and trying non-stop our build. Finally and most important we have been working on improving the performance of the game, so that it runs smoothly on launch. Things are starting to look Ready! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640166/d2eda81d2d6677a7c894142c399a2022e34e3207.png"][/img]Once again, thanks for all the support. We will see you all on Friday on the demo launch, we are excited to read your comment and opinions about it! Will also release the trailer of Dreadbone on Friday, so get ready it's gonna be an amazing day full of surprises. Finally, don't forget to wishlist Dreadbone, right now to be the first ones to play the demo ;)[/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3587460/Dreadbone/"]Wishlist Dreadbone[/url] to uncover what the island has buried.[/p][p]📅 Demo drops July 11th[/p][p]🎬 Full Trailer lands this Friday[/p]

notes.title: Powers of the Awaken Spirit: Relic, Earthquake and Pollen
notes.notes: [h1]The Spirit Stirs Again [/h1][p]Dreadbone isn't about a hero with a sword. It's about somethin older, something buried. [/p][p]You are [b]Tz'akabaak[/b], the Earth Spirit. Once worshipped across the Island, your body was sealed long ago. But not everything was lost. The temples crumbled. The Jungle grew wild. Yet deep below your power held on fractured, quiet and waiting. Now you're awake and even with what little remains of your strength, three forces still answer your call: [b]The Relic and the Earthquake and the Pollen. [/b][/p][h2]The Relic[/h2][p]The relics were once offerings. Statues used to connect with you when you were still a god. Now, they're how you reach out again. Remember you don't control Henry, but the relic lets you guide him. It reconnects broken paths, makes roads appear that were long forgotten. It will help you guide henry through the island, making him come closer to you. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640166/dd0a0d4e243356c6a8ce29048028481eccb0c019.gif"][/img][/p][h2]The Earthquake [/h2][p]The island still listens, but only when you're in the right spot. In your spirit form, you can rise or lower the terrain at your will. You can open up new routes, block off danger or tear through what's in the way. It's not a spell, it's your old strength pushing though the cracked earth. As you can see with this mechanics on you side, your freedom get's closer and closer. Henry is on his way towards you. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640166/192e489f22e84bd692154db3963815a3fc02e4ca.gif"][/img][/p][h2]The Pollen[/h2][p]Ancient trees once blessed by Tz'akabaak still remain, scattered across the island, quiet and reminiscing from an age when you ruled. Their roots run deep into sacred grounds, and the pollen carry the whispers of a forgotten god. You can still trigger this trees freezing enemies in place, clouding their senses and disabling their ability to attack. It's not just defense. It's a sign the jungle hasn't forgotten you. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640166/559e592b46766e1af8d3bd4afce11f30a12ffd21.gif"][/img][/p][h2]The Island Responds[/h2][p]This is just the beginning. More powers are buried. More forces  will wake. But for now, these three are enough. The tools are in place and for the first time in a whole the path is starting to open. Dreadbone is changing and it knows you're back. [/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3587460/Dreadbone/"]Wishlist Dreadbone[/url][b] and be the first to reshape the forgotten.[/b][/p][p]📅 [b]Demo drops July 11th — only one week left.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Meet the Inhabitants: Spirit, Explorer, and the Creatures Left Behind
notes.notes:
[h1]Spirit, Explorer and Creatures [/h1][p]The island isn’t empty. It was never meant to be. Beneath the ruins, under all vegetation lies a mighty god Imprisoned and seeking to escape. While on the shore an explorer has just arrived seeking to uncover the truth behind his grandparent disappearance. [/p][h3]Tz’akabaak[/h3][p]Once a god. Now, just a shadow. Tz’akabaak was the Spirit of Earth, a mighty being worshiped by an entire civilization. Offerings were always given to earn his favor; seeds, bones and flowers. His power shaped the island itself, raising mountains, opening caves, and feeding the ground with life or death. [/p][p]But betrayal broke him. Now trapped beneath the island, imprisoned by the same rituals that once fed him, Tz’akabaak now exists only as a spirit; desperate, weakened but not yet gone. He wants to be freed.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640166/8a25f251678a896cfb3de783c238dc83a25bc610.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Henry Walker[/h3][p]A cartographer. A grandson. A survivor. [/p][p]Henry didn’t come to Dreadbone for glory nor riches. He came searching for answers to uncover what happened to his grandfather, one of the first to step foot on the island.. and never return. [/p][p]He doesn't know that the island itself is alive. That something beneath the soil stirs. Without realizing it, he’s become part of the island, caught between the bones of the past and something that refuses to die. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640166/5c5822aefab3d1b4ab5f0942e12dcd87cdd8feea.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]The Creatures of Dreadbone [/b][/h2][h3]Crawby [/h3][p]Once a humble protector of temple grounds, the Crawby now stalks the jungle ruins twisted by centuries without purpose. Their original purpose was to guard the sacred spaces and patrol ceremonial paths, these creatures operate in silence, responding only to intrusions. Once everyone vanished, they still stayed on patrol. [/p][p]Their thick shells make them resistant to most threats, and their pincers can crush stone. They are territorial, relentless and hungry. They no longer recognize friend from foe. The jungle has become their nest, and anything that wanders too deep is treated as prey. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640166/427fb9a8b4c9866580d8fe5e52f8f573bdd7c005.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Escaramoc [/h3][p]Perched above cliffs or temple walls, Escaramoc are ranged guardians. They were created as the first line of defense, watchers that never blink. Their role was simple: repel from above, let nothing approach the sacred grounds unchecked. When the temples fell in silence, they stayed in place still vigilant and waiting. [/p][p]They feed on rocks and sediment, using it to produce a corrosive, sticky substance they fire with disturbing precision. These projectiles are considered deadly, so tread carefully around the island. If you hear something crunching nearby, you should start running. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640166/e92e4d8fe56b539b646d5204bbc9f1a4e57e2570.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]The Island Awaits [/b][/h2][p]This is the ecosystem of Dreadbone. A forgotten god. A lone explorer. And the remnants of a once loyal and serving army, now twisted and confused. Step carefully, many dangers are waiting for you.  [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3587460/Dreadbone/"]Wishlist Dreadbone now[/url] and prepare to face the challenge! [/p][p]Demo drops July 11th - 8 days to go! [/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Meet the Island: A Land Shaped by Betrayal and Time
notes.notes: [h1][b]From Sacred Ground to Broken Ruins [/b][/h1][p]Bone Island was the heart of an ancient civilization. A place where mortals once walked side by side with god, the earth spirit, Tz’akabaak. They worshipped him through offerings of bones, seed and jade. This was a place where faith was carved into stone, and the ground itself was shaped by divine hands. But faith turned into rebellion. Betrayal led to catastrophe. In a war waged between gods and mankind, Tz'akabaak was defeated, his body torn apart and buried beneath the very altars built in his name, The temples crumbled. His worshippers vanished and the creatures he had created were left behind, guardians of a fallen god, became predators of anyone foolish enough to trespass. [/p][p]Nature reclaimed everything. Temples lie half-sunken, their walls tangled with roots, golden altars overtaken by moss. The jungle grew dense, suffocating, turning paths into mazes where statues and ruins vanish beneath all the vegetation. Caves yawn where the earth collapsed, and forgotten altars still mark the burial sites of the old god. This is no longer just an island, it’s a graveyard, a labyrinth, and a monument to a past the world chose to forget. This island now bears a different name, now it’s called Dreadbone. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640166/2dcd41f160a78070b7f04a2a6432cd05ff1d8ec3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640166/2f7863a02e808e550858f61e62f6807f4946316c.png"][/img][/p][p]This broken landscape isn’t just scenery it’s the puzzle itself[b].[/b] In [b]Dreadbone[/b], the land is both your obstacle and your tool. You’ll collapse cliffs to open new paths, raise the earth to reach hidden ruins, or block threats. Prepare yourself! mastering how to read and manipulate the terrain is the only way forward.[/p][p]Now, for the first time in centuries, Tz’akabaak has seized his opportunity. Trapped deep beneath the island, sealed within his eternal prison, the fallen Spirit can do little… but it’s enough. With the fragments of power he still possesses, he must guide the explorer to his salvation, hoping he is the key to setting him free.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640166/0cccc3e69a92560c1140389f873c1395e7186e8e.png"][/img][/p][p]As you can see, the island is full of mysteries and surprises. Now that you know the backstory of Dreadbone, you know who ruled over this place, a forgotten power, broken but never truly gone. Its presence although weak still lingers beneath the roots, buried in the cracks, watching and waiting. Some things were never meant to be found. [/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3587460/Dreadbone/"]Wishlist Dreadbone now[/url] to be the first to uncover what lies within.[/p][p]📅 [b]Demo drops July 11th — don’t miss it.[/b][/p]
